parent_objective: audit one-seed fixed-budget profile smoke before deciding whether to run a 3-seed public pilot
blocked_by: M1386 passes plumbing but one-seed profile trends are not architecture-ranking evidence
supersedes: scaling directly to 3-seed public pilot without result audit
claiming profile ranking from one seed

public_gates: M1387 must audit M1386 as plumbing evidence first
M1387 must classify L2-vs-current-tiled and L3-vs-reset signals
M1387 must decide whether 3-seed public pilot, stronger diagnostic, repair, or branch stop is next
M1387 must not train, run PPO, run new evaluation, promote, use private holdout, export corpus, or claim profile ranking
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim architecture ranking from one seed

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits one-seed fixed-budget profile smoke before scaling to a 3-seed public pilot
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no training, new evaluation, PPO, promotion, private holdout, high-fidelity, profile-ranking, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if one-seed profile trends are overclaimed
stop if current-tiled parity is ignored
stop if L3 online-vs-reset parity is ignored
stop if 3-seed pilot is admitted without a cost/evidence argument
fallback_plan: if plumbing pass is enough, route to 3-seed public pilot design
if current-frame substitution dominates, route to stronger history-necessity diagnostic
if profile behavior is too weak, route to task/curriculum design
if branch value is low, route to synthesis or stop

admission_evidence: M1386 completed all eight profile seed runs with finite metrics
M1386 one-seed trends show L2/current-tiled parity and L3/reset parity
M1386 did not use private holdout, promotion, profile tuning, or actor-input changes
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: one-seed profile trend limitations are classified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1387 must treat L0 strength and L2/current-tiled parity as active current-frame substitution risk.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: One public training seed and 32 public eval seeds per profile.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If one-seed signals are negative or inconclusive, record them and choose route explicitly instead of weakening claim standards.
allowed_claims: one-seed profile smoke audit and next route
no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, paper-result, or architecture-ranking claim

hypothesis: M1386 can be audited as a clean one-seed plumbing pass while preserving claim boundaries before deciding whether to scale to 3 seeds.
success_criteria: audit summarizes M1386 completion and finite metric status
audit classifies L2/current-tiled and L3/reset one-seed signals
audit chooses next route without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, actor-input expansion, or profile-ranking claim
failure_criteria: audit overclaims one-seed results as architecture ranking
audit ignores current-tiled or reset-control parity
audit routes directly to private holdout, promotion, or paper-level claim
decision_rule: M1387 passes if it audits M1386 and chooses the next route before any new training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or profile-ranking claim.
